name: Collateral Parameters 13
definition: Parameters which explicitly state the conditions that must be fulfilled before a particular triparty collateral instruction/transaction  can be confirmed. These parameters are defined by the instructing party in compliance with triparty collateral rules in the market the instruction/transaction will take place.

CollateralInstructionType.name: Collateral Instruction Type
CollateralInstructionType.definition: Specifies the type of collateral instruction.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the exposure.

CollateralSide.name: Collateral Side
CollateralSide.definition: Specifies whether the client is the collateral taker or giver.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies the priority with which the instruction needs to be executed.

AutomaticAllocation.name: Automatic Allocation
AutomaticAllocation.definition: Specifies whether the allocation of the collateral is manual or automatic.

CollateralApproved.name: Collateral Approved
CollateralApproved.definition: Indicates whether the proposed collateral movements can be accepted.

SettlementApproved.name: Settlement Approved
SettlementApproved.definition: Indicates whether the proposed collateral movements have settled or not.

CollateralAmount.name: Collateral Amount
CollateralAmount.definition: Specifies the amount of the collateral.
